terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.preamble: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between members and the operator of PanZone (the "Service"). By agreeing to these Terms, you enter into a service agreement with the operator.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These Terms set forth the conditions and procedures for using features the operator provides — PUBG stats lookup, community boards, notifications, and related functionality — and the rights, obligations, and responsibilities of both parties.

sections.heading: 2. Definitions
sections.body:
- "Service" refers to all features operated under PanZone, including stats lookup, community boards, notifications, and ancillary features.
- "Member" refers to any person who accepts these Terms, completes email verification, and registers an account.
- "Content" refers to any posts, comments, images, polls, or other material submitted by a Member to the Service.
- "Operator" refers to the individual who operates and administers the Service.

sections.heading: 3. Effect and Changes to the Terms
sections.body:
1. These Terms take effect once a Member agrees to them and begins using the Service.
2. The Operator may modify these Terms when required by changes in law, service policy, or operations.
3. Any changes will be announced within the Service at least 7 days in advance (or 30 days in advance for changes adverse to Members).
4. If a Member does not agree to the revised Terms, they may discontinue use by deleting their account.

sections.heading: 4. Registration and Account Management
sections.body:
1. This Service is open only to users aged 14 or older. Registration by users under 14 is restricted pursuant to Article 22-2 of Korea's Personal Information Protection Act.
2. Registration requires verification of an email address owned by the Member.
3. Creating multiple accounts per person is prohibited.
4. Members are responsible for safeguarding their account credentials. The Operator is not liable for loss resulting from negligent credential management.
5. Nicknames that imply an official affiliation (e.g., trademark names or staff impersonation) are blocked at registration.

sections.heading: 5. Member Obligations and Prohibited Conduct
sections.body:
Members shall comply with applicable laws and these Terms, and shall not engage in any of the following:
- Impersonating another person or misusing another's credentials
- Spamming or repeatedly posting identical/near-identical content
- Posting unauthorized advertising or promotional content
- Using abusive, hateful, discriminatory, or harassing language
- Posting adult, sexual, illegal, or violent content
- Infringing third-party copyright, image rights, or privacy
- Interfering with Service operation (hacking, scraping, abnormal access)
- Any other act that violates laws or public order and morals

sections.heading: 6. Copyright and Usage License for Content
sections.body:
1. Copyright in Content remains with the Member who created it.
2. Members grant the Operator a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use their Content for the following purposes:
- Displaying and transmitting Content within the Service
- Limited exposure for Service promotion
- Retention and backup as required by law
3. This license terminates when the Member deletes the Content or their account. Portions may remain if quoted in other Members' Content.
4. Members are solely responsible for any copyright infringement in their Content.

sections.heading: 7. Reporting and Use Restrictions
sections.body:
1. Members may use the "Report" feature to flag inappropriate Content to the Operator.
2. The Operator may take the following actions against Members who violate these Terms or materially disrupt the Service:
- Delete or blind affected Content
- Issue a warning
- Temporarily or permanently suspend the account
3. Suspended Members may file an appeal under Section 8.

sections.heading: 8. Appeals and Account Recovery
sections.body:
1. Members may dispute any action taken against them via the "Inquiry" feature on their profile page.
2. The Operator will review appeals in good faith and respond with the outcome.
3. If a suspension is not lifted within 30 days, the Member's Content and profile data are automatically deleted and cannot be recovered.
4. Re-registration with the same email or nickname is subject to the Operator's discretion.

sections.heading: 9. Account Deletion
sections.body:
1. Members may delete their account at any time from the profile page.
2. Upon deletion, the Member's posts and comments are removed and personally identifying information is destroyed.
3. For the integrity of other Members' discussions, deleted comments may remain visible as "deleted comment" placeholders preserving thread structure.

sections.heading: 10. Service Changes and Suspension
sections.body:
1. The Operator may temporarily suspend parts of or all of the Service due to maintenance, incident recovery, force majeure, or other unavoidable reasons.
2. The Operator may discontinue the entire Service for reasonable cause, with at least 30 days' advance notice.

sections.heading: 11. Disclaimer of Liability
sections.body:
1. The Service is a non-commercial, unofficial fan community. The Operator is not responsible for transactions between Members, disputes between Members, or the accuracy of Content.
2. The Operator is not liable for service interruptions or data loss caused by force majeure, server failure, hacking, or other events outside the Operator's control.
3. The Service is not officially affiliated with KRAFTON, PUBG STUDIOS, or their subsidiaries. All trademarks such as PUBG and BATTLEGROUNDS are property of their respective owners and are used here only within the scope of nominative fair use.
4. The Operator is not responsible for the content of external links or third-party services (e.g., advertising networks, email providers).

sections.heading: 12. Advertising
sections.body: The Service may display advertisements through third-party ad networks such as Google AdSense to cover operating costs. Handling of personal data in connection with ads is governed by the Privacy Policy and the respective ad network's policies.

sections.heading: 13. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
sections.body:
1. These Terms and any dispute arising from use of the Service shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea.
2. Any dispute shall be brought before the competent court under the Korean Civil Procedure Act.

sections.heading: 14. Contact
sections.body: For questions, reports, or appeals, please use the "Inquiry" feature within the Service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.preamble: PanZone (the "Service") complies with applicable laws including Korea's Personal Information Protection Act and makes every effort to protect user privacy. This policy explains how the Service collects, uses, retains, and deletes personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
**Required**
- Email address
- Nickname
- Password (stored as a bcrypt hash; original cannot be recovered)

**Optional**
- Profile image
- Short bio

**Automatically Collected**
- IP address, access timestamps
- Cookies (session, language preference)
- Browser and OS info

**Provided by the User**
- Posts, comments, uploaded images, poll responses
- Content and attachments submitted via reports or inquiries

sections.heading: 2. Purposes of Collection and Use
sections.body:
- Account creation and identity verification
- Providing the Service (posting, commenting, notifications, etc.)
- Preventing abuse (multiple accounts, impersonation, spam)
- Enforcement of usage rules and processing appeals
- Aggregate analytics for service improvement (non-identifying)

sections.heading: 3. Retention Period
sections.body:
- Account info: retained until account deletion and then destroyed, except where retention is mandated by law
- Content: retained until account deletion or user-initiated deletion
- If an account is suspended and not reinstated within 30 days, associated Content and profile data are automatically destroyed (taking into account the appeal window)
- Access logs: 3 months under Korea's Protection of Communications Secrets Act
- Abuse records: up to 1 year for abuse-prevention purposes

sections.heading: 4. Disclosure to Third Parties
sections.body:
The Service does not disclose personal information to external parties, except:
- With the user's prior consent
- Pursuant to law or a formal request from an authorized agency for investigative purposes

sections.heading: 5. Processors (External Services)
sections.body:
The Service entrusts portions of personal-data processing to the following parties to operate effectively.

**Email delivery (signup verification, password reset)**
- Processor: Resend Inc.
- Data: email address
- Purpose: sending verification codes and temporary passwords

**Advertising**
- Processor: Google LLC (Google AdSense)
- Data: cookies, IP address, advertising identifiers, service usage records
- Purpose: serving and measuring personalized advertising
- Policy: https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
sections.body:
The Service uses cookies for:
- Maintaining login sessions
- Storing language and theme preferences
- Personalizing advertising via Google AdSense

You can refuse or delete cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work. Google ad cookies can be managed individually at https://adssettings.google.com.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.body:
You may exercise the following rights at any time:
- Access: view your account information on your profile page
- Correction: use the profile editor
- Deletion: use the account-deletion feature on your profile page
- Processing halt: submit a request via the "Inquiry" feature

Legal guardians acting for users under 14 may exercise these rights on the user's behalf through the same channels.

sections.heading: 8. Security Measures
sections.body:
- Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes and cannot be decrypted.
- Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS.
- Administrative access is granted only to the minimum number of personnel, and access events are logged.
- Regular backups and access controls are in place.

sections.heading: 9. Deletion Procedure
sections.body:
- Upon account deletion, identifying fields (email, nickname) are immediately anonymized to prevent re-registration conflicts, and profile images, bios, and posts are destroyed.
- Electronic records are deleted in a manner that prevents recovery. Any physical printouts are shredded or incinerated.

sections.heading: 10. Data Protection Officer
sections.body:
Inquiries regarding personal-information handling are received by the following representative.
- Name: PanZone Administrator
- How to reach: "Inquiry" feature within the Service

sections.heading: 11. Remedies
sections.body:
For consultation or reporting of privacy violations, you may contact:
- Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (kopico.go.kr / +82-1833-6972)
- Personal Information Protection Commission (privacy.go.kr / 1833-6972)
- Supreme Prosecutors' Office Cybercrime Investigation (spo.go.kr / 1301)
- Korean National Police Cyber Bureau (ecrm.cyber.go.kr / 182)

sections.heading: 12. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in law, service policy, or security practices. Updates will be announced within the Service in advance. Material changes will also be communicated via direct notification.
